observe.surface: Discord: slash-command replies, ephemeral panels with select menus and buttons, modals, channel messages, reactions and replies sent by the barnacle bot
observe.value: The exact message text, component rows, reactions and stored rows the bot produces for a given interaction or message
observe.observe_by: cargo test --workspace against the pure builders and stores in crates/barnacle-bot/tests, plus a local dev bot probe in a test server
observe.terminal_action: The panel's final button (Create, Start competition, Save) or the reaction or message event that commits the change to the database
observe.build_artifact: The barnacle Docker image built by .github/workflows/image.yml and checked by .github/scripts/smoke.sh
observe.twin: Every panel built in crates/barnacle-bot/src/event_draft.rs and the command handlers in crates/barnacle-bot/src/discord/commands.rs
observe.dependent: The sign-up timer, attendance store and announcer that read stored events; migrations/ and smoke.sh for schema changes
observe.compat_boundary: The Discord API (slash-command registration and component payloads) and the SQLite schema under migrations/

residue.access: The .env token is a dev bot; running it locally against a test server is authorized for probes
residue.shortcut: /rehearse start and /rehearse next move a rehearsal server's clock so timed behaviour can be stepped through
residue.fixtures: Tests seed their own data through crates/barnacle-bot/tests/common; live probes need a test server with roles
residue.special_surfaces: How the Discord client renders components and autocomplete labels, which only a live client shows
